Randomly sample sequences from a FASTA file (Linux, VSEARCH-based)

Source: R/vtamR_fun.R
random_sample_linux.Rd

Randomly selects n sequences from an input FASTA file using fastx_subsample from VSEARCH.

Usage

random_sample_linux(
  fasta,
  outfile,
  n = 1e+06,
  vsearch_path = NULL,
  compress_method = "R",
  pigz_path = NULL,
  randseed = NULL,
  quiet = TRUE,
  num_threads = 0
)

Arguments

fasta

Character string: path to the input FASTA file (optionally gzipped).

outfile

Character string: path to the output FASTA file. If it ends in .gz, the output will be gzip-compressed.

n

Positive integer: number of sequences to randomly sample.

vsearch_path

Optional path to the vsearch executable. If NULL (default), resolved via getOption("vtamR.vsearch_path") or the PATH (see get_path).

compress_method

Character or logical: compression method used for output files. Must be one of "pigz", "gzip", or "R".

  • "pigz" requires pigz to be installed and available in the system PATH (or specified via pigz_path).

  • "gzip" is Linux-only.

  • "R" uses R.utils and is cross-platform but slower. Performance (fastest → slowest): pigz > gzip > R.

pigz_path

Optional path to the pigz executable. If NULL (default), resolved via getOption("vtamR.pigz_path") or the PATH (see get_path).

randseed

Integer or NULL: random seed for sampling. If NULL or 0 (default), a pseudo-random seed is used. A non-zero seed ensures reproducible results.

quiet

Logical: if TRUE, suppress informational messages; only warnings and errors are shown.

num_threads

Positive integer: number of CPU threads to use. If 0, all available CPUs are used.

Value

Invisibly returns the number of sequences written to the output file.

Details

This function is Linux-specific. For a cross-platform alternative, use random_sample_r().

The input FASTA file can be uncompressed or gzipped. Output compression is inferred from the output file extension (i.e., .gz produces a gzipped file).

If the input file contains fewer than or exactly n sequences, it is copied to the output file, preserving the requested compression format.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
random_sample_linux(
  fasta = "all_sequences.fasta.gz",
  outfile = "subset_100.fasta.gz",
  n = 100,
  randseed = 123,
  quiet = FALSE
)
} # }
